generationInputs.prompt: Create a dramatic, moody image of a podcast microphone and a pair of over-ear headphones resting on a table, lit by a single spotlight against a dark background. The focus should be on the equipment, symbolizing podcasting as a space for deep conversation. Use high contrast between light and shadow. Add subtle background details like acoustic panels or sound waves in abstract. Style: cinematic, photo-realistic or semi-realistic, with neutral tones (black, gray, dark blue). No text, no people, no explicit elements—just atmosphere and symbolism."
